Security and reliability release, from a full audit of the code, the skill and the release process.

- **Files and secrets:** exclusions (`.env*`, `.git`, credentials) ignore letter case and also apply to files `local_edit` creates; secrets in JSON and in names like `client_secret` are masked without shifting line numbers; folders containing a credentials file are read instead of failing.
- **Quotes:** only whitespace and line breaks between adjacent lines may differ from the source; two projects with the same relative path are told apart.
- **`local_edit`:** atomic writes, nothing overwritten when a file changed while the model was working, restore only what was written, gate commands validated and documented as running with your rights.
- **Local only:** Ollama cloud models are refused (by name and by remote host) and Ollama is started with `OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1`. `readscout stop` reports models that stayed loaded.
- **Setup:** small machines get a matching model recommendation, unknown web actions are rejected, config writes are locked, the Codex install validates the TOML and keeps a backup, `install.sh` installs nothing without a terminal to ask.
- **Benchmark:** scoring is stricter (published scores are upper bounds until re-measured).
- **Release:** tests and a version check run before building, `SHA256SUMS` is published, `mcp>=1.23`.

Update: run the installer again, or `uv tool install --force https://github.com/Anarchiejs/readscout/releases/download/v0.1.2/readscout-0.1.2-py3-none-any.whl`.
Plugin users: `/plugin marketplace update readscout`, then restart Claude Code.
